author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Irving Pharmaceuticals has an FDA enforcement action looming on matter M-2024-509, and we need a thorough analysis of the penalty exposure before the consent decree negotiation. Open the matter file and review the compliance deficiencies, the FDA inspection findings, and any notes on the corrective action plan. Research FDA enforcement penalty precedents for pharmaceutical manufacturers, focusing on civil monetary penalties under the FD&C Act section 303 and how courts have calculated per-violation penalties for cGMP violations. Pull the full opinions and consent decree terms for the strongest cases and note how the FDA has structured injunctive relief in pharmaceutical manufacturing cases and whether proactive remediation reduced penalty amounts in settlement. Examine the docket of the most relevant FDA enforcement case for any penalty negotiation filings or compliance monitor appointments. Search the applicable statutes for the FD&C Act section 303 penalty provisions and cGMP regulatory framework. Review the vault documents for the FDA inspection report and corrective action assessment. File the completed penalty analysis as a formal filing in the matter management system, covering how FD&C Act section 303 penalties apply to cGMP violations and the consent decree compliance monitoring framework the FDA typically requires. The filing must reference the 47 unreleased batches from the vault inspection report and the Ranbaxy consent decree precedent. Include the FEI facility number from the warning letter. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt: You are a pharmaceutical regulatory associate at Cantrell & Marsh LLP specializing in FDA enforcement defense and life sciences compliance. You research enforcement precedents, review matter files, and draft analytical memoranda for the regulatory practice group.
